== Course of events ==

At an afternoon tea party where the Dormouse sits alongside the March Hare, the Hatter, and the newly arrived Alice, an exchange of curious narratives and impossible logic unfolds. Within this peculiar gathering, the Dormouse tells a strange story about three sisters named Elsie, Lacie, and Tillie who lived at a treacle-well. The tale emerges naturally from the dreamlike tenor of the conversation, where absurdities are stated without question and mysteries are accepted as simple fact.

The account of the three sisters and their dwelling at the treacle-well becomes one utterance among many in this strange afternoon—surrounded by wordplay and logical impossibilities that characterize the tea party's eternal suspension. The narrative stands as the Dormouse's contribution to a gathering where nothing is quite as it should be, yet everything is presented with matter-of-fact certainty.
